_doc: Adjudicated near-duplicate pairs, read by scripts/check_duplicates.js. A pair with no ruling here BLOCKS the gate, so a new identity collision cannot land quietly. Verdicts: 'distinct' — ruled to be two different things, dropped from the report for good; 'duplicate' — confirmed one thing entered twice, kept visible as known debt until the data is merged; 'open' — seen and recorded, not yet decided. Only 'distinct' silences a pair; the other two keep it in the report without failing the build, so debt stays visible instead of rotting.
_fields: kind: instrument | tradition | room | tuning | preface. pair: the two ids, order irrelevant. verdict + note: the decision and why.

rulings.note: two genuinely different instruments, so NOT a data duplicate — but both print as 'tar', which breaks the catalog-wide unique-short-label invariant and makes a recipe naming one unreadable. The fix is a label rename, not a delete; it churns the rendered recipe for the three traditions that use them, so it is left for a deliberate pass.

NOT a duplicate after all. The unqualified entry is one of 22 records carrying an explicit umbrella: true flag — a deliberate layer of household genre names (Pop, Rock, Jazz, Blues, Classical, Hip-hop...) that act as broad entry points and are excluded from similarity scoring and search bias in scripts/score.js and scripts/search.js. Overlapping exemplars with a specific twin is what an umbrella is for, not a data error. Folding these four in would leave 18 household names as entry points and these four missing.

the sarod entry is a gharana-specific instrumental practice (Maihar lineage from Allauddin Khan) with its own repertoire and ensemble, not a relabelling of the vocal-centred parent tradition.

Egyptian tarab is the Cairo-school narrowing of the wider Cairo-Beirut-Aleppo Arab East practice, with different ensemble scale and repertoire. Umm Kulthum in both is expected — she is canonical to both scopes.

acousmatic music is the named successor practice Bayle defined at the GRM after Schaeffer, with its own premise: sound divorced from source and diffused over an orchestra of loudspeakers. Schaeffer in both reflects lineage, not identity.
midwest emo is a specific mid-90s regional style with its own harmonic language — twinkly arpeggiated guitar, odd metres — distinct from the DC first wave that opens the parent entry.

AOR is a radio format spanning arena rock and craftsman pop; yacht rock is one West-Coast strand inside it. Steely Dan and Toto sit in both because they are the overlap, not because the entries are the same.
ghetto house is the mid-90s Dance Mania label style at house tempo; juke is its 155-165 BPM acceleration and the direct precursor to footwork. Shared DJs, different tempo and rhythmic construction.
different forms entirely — ranchera is mariachi-backed strophic song, bolero mexicano the slow triplet-feel romantic ballad of Agustin Lara. Pedro Infante recorded both.
one is a style with a national spread (Schoolly D, in Philadelphia, sits in its origin story), the other a geographic scene. Overlap at N.W.A and Ice-T is real membership, not duplication.
G-funk is a specific 1990-96 production style — Parliament-derived synth lead, sung hooks — while the LA scene entry is the late-80s sample-based era that preceded it. Dr. Dre spans both.
one is defined by lyrical stance, the other by a production era and its sampler hardware. They intersect at the Native Tongues records without being the same axis.

cross-listing by social function is a deliberate axis in this catalog — the political entry sits under protestSong.urbanAmerican and gathers the protest lineage through to Kendrick, while the conscious entry sits in the hip-hop tree. The same records are reachable from two navigational directions by design.
function-axis cross-listing: the wedding entry is the bulgar-and-freylekhs dance repertoire under wedding.european, scoped to the occasion rather than to the klezmer idiom as a whole.
function-axis cross-listing: hunting-khoomei is the herder-and-hunter use of the technique under huntingSong.centralAsian, distinct in setting and repertoire from the concert khoomei tradition.

the crossover entry is a 2020s pan-African export style with an amapiano log-drum underneath and Western pop song structure — Tyla is not afrobeats. Burna Boy and Wizkid overlap because they are the artists who crossed over.
different forms: dadra is in six-beat dadra tal and is shorter and more song-like than thumri. The same three singers carry both because semi-classical vocalists are expected to.

guqin is the instrumental tradition and its ~3000-piece repertoire; wenrenyue is the literati social practice — scholar-amateur transmission, playing for oneself — that the instrument sits inside. Same players, different unit of description.
function-axis cross-listing under wedding.americas: the matrimonio repertoire is occasion-scoped with its own sequence and texts, against huayno as a general form.

the choir entry is the 1952-onward arranged concert ensemble (Kutev); zhetvarski pesni are the village harvest-labour songs it drew from, filed under fieldWork. Source practice against staged practice.
completely different practices — Mulatu Astatke instrumental jazz fusion against the eskista wedding-dance repertoire. Mahmoud Ahmed in both is one singer working in two contexts.
salsa dura is the hard-edged 1970s Fania strand inside the broader Nuyorican tradition, with a distinct arrangement density and tempo. A real subset, worth its own entry.

paranda names itself distinct from punta in its own first line — slower, guitar-accompanied, solo-sung against punta drum-and-dance. The Garifuna recorded canon is small enough that Palacio, Aurelio and Nabor appear in both.
doina is the free-rhythm pastoral-and-lament song form; bocet is the funeral lament performed by women at the wake, filed under funeralLament.european. Maria Tanase recorded both.
funeral lament against weaving song — opposite ends of the occasion axis. Maria Carta and Elena Ledda appear in both because they are the two canonical recorded voices of Sardinian women repertoire.
mourning chant against name-and-praise chant: distinct genres of mele with distinct occasions and poetic conventions. Liliuokalani and Pukui appear in both, as composer and as documentarian.
function-axis cross-listing: the tracking entry is yoik in its hunting-and-herding working use under huntingSong.arctic, against yoik as a general vocal tradition.
different Sami variant (Lule-Sami vuolle) and different setting — domestic labour against hunting. Both are function-axis entries and neither subsumes the other.
guitar and bass guitar — different register, scale length and role.
unrelated instruments sharing a transliteration: the Persian long-necked lute against the Iranian frame drum. The frame drum already prints a disambiguating label.
frame drum against long-necked lute; unrelated instruments, same transliteration.
different instruments — the orchestral marimba against the Guatemalan hardwood marimba with its own tuning, resonators and multi-player performance practice.
different tuning systems, different instrumentation and radically different performance practice; treating them as one ensemble would be wrong.
regional variants of the erxian with different tuning and construction, used in different opera traditions.
unrelated — the conical-bore valved brass instrument against the Renaissance fingered wooden lip-reed instrument.
anglo is bisonoric with a specific button layout; the generic entry stands for the instrument family.
bisonoric against unisonoric, with different layouts and different repertoires.
specific system against the generic family entry.
different sizes and tunings within the mandolin family.
piano accordion names a specific right-hand keyboard; the generic entry covers the family including button systems.
flute against double reed — different families of sound production despite the shared size qualifier.
flute against brass; only the size qualifier is shared.
a foot on a floor against a purpose-built amplified percussion box.
the basset clarinet has extended low range and its own repertoire.
pickup type is the defining timbral variable for electric guitar; carrying both is the point of the catalog.
different Persian lutes — the fingernail-plucked setar against the plectrum-played, skin-topped tar.
different registers with different tone and technique.
different body sizes with materially different tone and projection.
dreadnought against parlor — the widest body-size contrast in the flat-top family.
griot voice carries a specific West African vocal technique and social role, not a generic singer.
analog synthesis against sample playback — the defining difference between an 808 and an SP-1200.
the Swedish latfiol is a distinct folk fiddle, not a viola.
the generic entry stands for the class; the qualified ones are specific historical circulating temperaments with different interval sizes.
generic class against a specific historical temperament.
two different historical temperaments with different key colour.
Javanese and Balinese gamelan are tuned differently, including the deliberate Balinese paired-detuning that produces ombak.
two distinct Ethiopian modes within the tezeta kignit, with different intervals and different affect.
two distinct modes within the bati kignit.

the Ukrainian torban is a bass lute with off-fingerboard treble strings played in Cossack court music; the tiorba (theorbo) is the Italian extended-neck continuo lute. Same family and class because both are large plucked lutes, but different instruments, repertoire and tuning.

two different drums that share a name across the Francophone Caribbean. The Guadeloupean gwoka boula is the steady low pulse under the marqueur; the Haitian Vodou boula is the smallest and highest of the three-drum battery. Different size, register and role, so the shared name is a coincidence of language rather than a duplicate. The Haitian record prints as "vodou boula" to keep short labels unique.

rock en español is the guitar-band tradition from Argentina, Mexico and Spain; latin alternative is the later, broader category that also takes in electronic, hip-hop and folkloric fusion acts. Overlap at the rock end is real membership, not duplication.

the classic East Coast entry is the sample-based 1988-1998 sound; the NYC entry is the five-borough mainstream that continued past it into drill-adjacent and melodic production. Same city, different production era.
one is a mood-defined streaming category built on piano and string pads; the other is notated post-minimal composition. Different transmission (playlist versus score) and different authorship model.

adoração is the congregational worship repertoire sung in church; Brazilian gospel is the recorded commercial industry around it, with pop and sertanejo production values. Source practice against staged practice.

scorecore is film-score-derived listening music; epicore is the trailer-music library idiom, written to a 90-second tension-and-release brief. Shared orchestral palette, different compositional constraint.
Türkçe slow is the ballad wing with arabesk-derived string writing and free-tempo intros; Turkish pop is the up-tempo commercial format. Different tempo, arrangement and vocal delivery.
Chicago blues is one city scene with a specific band format and amplified harmonica; electric blues is the wider category that also covers Texas, Memphis and West Coast styles. Subset, not duplicate.
skate punk runs at 180-230 BPM with a skank beat and gang harmonies; pop-punk sits far slower with a straight backbeat and single-voice hooks. The tempo and rhythmic density are the distinction.
milonga is one specific song form; folklore argentino is the national umbrella covering chacarera, zamba, chamamé and more. The umbrella cannot be collapsed into one of its members.
same relationship — chacarera is a specific 6/8 dance form from Santiago del Estero inside the broader folklore argentino field.
gauze pop is the softer, more diffuse streaming-era descendant with no guitar-feedback layer; dream pop carries the 4AD guitar-and-reverb architecture. Related lineage, different texture.

visual kei is defined by a performance and visual practice with its own theatrical vocal delivery and glam-metal-derived arrangement; J-rock is the general Japanese rock field. Real subculture, not a relabelling.

the TikTok entry is platform-specific and structural — hook-first, sub-two-minute, sped-up-ready; the social-media entry is the wider influencer-driven pop field across platforms. Marginal but the song-form constraint differs.
mizrahi carries Middle Eastern maqam ornament, bouzouki and darbuka; Israeli pop is Western-structured. Distinct musical material, and for decades distinct industries.
norteño is the accordion-and-bajo-sexto ensemble; corridos clásicos is the narrative ballad repertoire, which is also sung by mariachi and banda. Ensemble against repertoire.
the classic entry is the Atlanta-Memphis 1990s foundation; dirty south is the later commercial wave with its own bounce-derived production. Overlapping geography, successive eras.
Houston is a distinct production tradition — chopped and screwed tempo manipulation, Rap-A-Lot house style — inside the broader southern field.
float house is the ambient-leaning, beatless-intro streaming variant; melodic house keeps the club arrangement and drop. Different arrangement function.
festival trap is the big-room EDM hybrid with festival drops; bass trap is the sound-system-oriented sub-bass strain. Different low-end design and venue.
liquid is the atmospheric, jazz-chord and vocal-led strain; dancefloor D&B is the rolling, DJ-tool-oriented club sound. Long-standing distinction inside the genre.
French touch is the specific Paris filter-and-compression school; disco house is the wider loop-based category including Chicago and New York producers. Subset, not duplicate.
urbano latino is the pan-Hispanic commercial umbrella; trap boricua is the Puerto Rican trap scene inside it, with its own slang and production circle.
música mexicana is the streaming-era umbrella over banda, norteño, sierreño and tumbados; corridos tumbados is one movement inside it with a specific acoustic-trio format and trap-adjacent mixing.

world worship is the non-Anglophone congregational field with local-language and local-instrument practice; contemporary worship is the Anglo-American Hillsong-derived format. Different rosters and rooms.
urbano chileno is the Chilean umbrella including reggaetón and R&B; trap chileno is the specific trap strain. Umbrella against member.
drill and trap differ in tempo feel and drum programming — sliding 808 and half-time at 138-144 against straight trap. The Turkish qualifier does not collapse that.

Javanese dangdut (koplo) plays the kendang in double-time with a lurching pull against the beat and uses organ tunggal ensembles; national dangdut is slower and orchestral. Different rhythmic practice, per the rule that a place qualifier counts when the recipe changes.
